blocks.text: The sprayer module is the implement of the real robot. The spec sheet gives its dry mass (50 kg); the photo ({fig:M03_sprayer_pump.jpg}) shows a brass piston pump with a pressure regulator under the chassis and a 12 x 8 mm high-pressure hose. Tank size, pump flow and nozzles are estimated.

blocks.caption: Sprayer pump under the chassis (source photo): brass piston pump with pressure regulator and high-pressure hose.
Sprayer module: real robot and model
rows: 50 kg, on the deck behind the centre
40 L (40 kg of liquid when full); liquid mass and CG follow the fill level
brass piston pump with pressure regulator
positive-displacement pump, about 9 L/min, bypass to 3 bar
24 V PM DC motor, PWM driver with soft start
1.2 m boom, 8 nozzles, 8 W valve each
12 mm OD x 8 mm ID, high pressure
pressure losses lumped in the pump model

blocks.text: In the model the sprayer is the `Impl_Sprayer` variant (`VC_IMPL = 3`). It draws its power through the implement contactor K3 and the 24 V rail, and the liquid in the tank is a variable point mass, so the robot gets lighter as it sprays. The spec render shows the module towed on a caster wheel; the model mounts it on the deck, which keeps the same mass with a simpler structure model.

blocks.caption: 3-D view of the model with the sprayer module: 40 L tank on the deck and the 1.2 m boom with 8 nozzles at the rear.
